name: image-mousetrail-default
title: Mouse Trail Default
blurb: Images trail cursor movement, accumulating on screen.
description: Container that displays a trail of images following cursor movement. Images accumulate until maximum count, then cycle. Uses CSS scale/opacity animations.
use_when: Interactive portfolios, galleries, or showcase sections where image trails add visual interest.
avoid_when: Mobile-only experiences or when persistent trails might clutter the viewport.
a11y: Trail images are decorative overlays; semantic content via children prop.
